objective: Under a frozen contract, measure with a general nilpotent braid model (BCH to degree 4) the layered obstruction of G = N x| C2 on gadget surgeries for several groups of class 3 and 4: test that it equals 2 sum_e sum_j <W_j^(3)(ell(x)), ell_j(s)> (degree-3 Lie part of the cable conjugators on all free minus classes), that bases have no obstruction, that abelian triple systems never obstruct, and that independent group-law counts agree.
status: Closed: supported under its frozen rule. Experiment TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001B-E001 measured the layered obstruction of N x| C2 on 2-surgeries with a general BCH braid model. The steering rule (Dynkin-evaluated degree-3 Lie part of the cable conjugators on all free minus classes, kappa = 2) held exactly on 36 of 36 fixture-algebra pairs: six nonabelian triple systems of class 3 and 4 (u4; free class 3 on two and three minus generators and on x+, y1-, y2-; class-4 cross-layer algebras), gadgets K3 and C4, p = 5, 7, 11. Bases and abelian triple systems never obstructed (42 of 42). The matrix model agreed for u4, and the independent group-law lifting test agreed on 24 of 24. All five negative controls failed to match. Report: research/TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001B/report.md.
title: Experiment: the four-way form of nonabelian triple systems of class 3 and 4 on gadget surgeries
